title: Migrate test plugin to contract v2
goal: Migrate plugins/tool/test to the v2 result contract: result_contract:2, mandatory disposition+reason fields, interrupted disposition for SIGTERM, release hook verified, no artifact path construction in code, valid_verdicts enforced.

steps.description: Write failing tests first (red step). Add new test cases to test-test.sh covering: (a) v2 result shape — result_contract=2, disposition, reason present on pass/fail/error paths; (b) #1747 SIGTERM disposition=interrupted (not broken); (c) release hook leaves staging dir on disk while killing pg; (d) grep assertion that plugin.sh constructs no artifact paths; (e) valid_verdicts in manifest covers every verdict the plugin emits. Run tests and confirm each new test FAILS before any implementation change.

Update _test_write_result in plugin.sh to emit result_contract:2 instead of schema_version:1, and add mandatory disposition and reason fields. On the pass/fail success path disposition='complete'. The fallback degenerate-but-valid JSON in the PIPESTATUS[0]!=0 guard also gets result_contract:2 and disposition='broken'. Carry all prior plugin-specific scalar fields (exit_code, passed, failed, test_output, diff_applied, test_cmd, run_mode) plus existing optional blocks (timing, tree_sha, lint, coverage, mutation) — no field removed. Plugin-specific detail (exit_code, passed, failed, test_output, diff_applied, test_cmd, run_mode, timing, tree_sha, lint, coverage, mutation) moves under a 'data' sub-object in the JSON as the issue requires.

Wire disposition on every non-success exit path. (a) The missing-diff-patch guard (early return) writes verdict=error, disposition=broken, reason=missing_diff_patch — a config bug, not recoverable. (b) The silent-failure (#485) path writes disposition=broken, reason=silent_failure. (c) The summary_unavailable path writes disposition=broken, reason=summary_unavailable. (d) A SIGTERM/interruption path (#1747): detect via kill signal (test_rc >= 128 and signal was SIGTERM/SIGKILL, or rc=130/143) and write disposition=interrupted, verdict=error, reason=interrupted. Nuance: only a signalled death is recoverable; rc=0 with unrecognised output remains broken. Implement _test_disposition_from_rc helper that maps rc to disposition.

Update manifest.yaml: add result_contract: 2 under provides: section (alongside existing role and events declarations). The test plugin is T0 (no LLM), so no router: budget block is needed. primary: true, valid_verdicts, provides.role, provides.events, and inputs: [] are all already correctly declared — no other manifest changes required.

Run npm test to confirm the full suite is green with the committed changes. Verify the before/after golden diff shows only the schema_version→result_contract rename and the new disposition/reason/data fields (no behavioural regression). Record the red step assertion and failure message in the PR body as required by CLAUDE.md.

notes: The test plugin already has primary:true output, valid_verdicts, provides.role, provides.events, and inputs:[]. The cleanup hook already correctly separates release (kill pg only) from purge (delete staging dir) — no structural inversion needed, only the disposition field in the result file. The RETURN trap already only kills the pg (not rm-rf). Plugin constructs no artifact paths from manifest ids in code — the acceptance grep will confirm. Template change is not needed: the test stage is already in deployed.yaml flow: under build_test_cycle. Coordination with #1772 (zero discovered test files exits 0) and #1784 (tree_sha) is handled by carrying those fields in the data block of the v2 result. The disposition=interrupted path for SIGTERM (#1747) must be distinguished from rc=0+unrecognised output (disposition=broken) — _test_disposition_from_rc implements that distinction.
